summary.answer: Type23 callbacks form append-only lists within the traced registration functions; the gadget-health and gated inventory registrations do not overwrite each other. Two further literal source sites add pickup-health on/off and a conditionally disabled-specialist off handler. Actual HMH audiences require their initializer/module gates and stored weapon.gadget_type23, not merely a health filename. Native event-shaped source wrappers forward entity/slot/weapon into dispatchers. Activation checks event weapon equals current slot; off and primed select current slot type without that explicit equality. Each matching handler is launched as a separate self thread, so list insertion order does not prove completion or write order. Possession callbacks are separate, and take clears its slot after thread-start statements without joining handlers. Inventory state marker writes, gadget heal-start and inventory debit are now connected to this dispatch boundary, with readiness/debit details left to their owners.
